name: 英语完形填空选择题库
subject: english

questions.question: Every day, Tom ___ to school by bus.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时，主语是Tom，第三人称单数，动词用goes。

questions.question: There ___ some water in the bottle.
questions.explanation: water是不可数名词，用单数形式。句子描述现在的情况，用一般现在时。

questions.question: My mother ___ cooking when I got home.
questions.explanation: when引导的时间状语从句，主句用过去进行时，be动词用was。

questions.question: If I ___ rich, I would buy a big house.
questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，if从句用过去式，be动词用were。

questions.question: The book ___ on the desk is mine.
questions.explanation: 现在分词lying作后置定语，表示正在进行的动作。

questions.question: She told me ___ the door.
questions.explanation: tell sb. to do sth.是固定搭配，意思是告诉某人做某事。

questions.question: Neither the teacher ___ the students knew the answer.
questions.explanation: neither...nor...是固定搭配，意思是既不...也不...

questions.question: ___ is known to all, the earth goes around the sun.
questions.explanation: as引导的非限制性定语从句，as is known to all意为众所周知。

questions.question: The boy is too young to ___ himself.
questions.explanation: too young to do something，动词用原形。dress oneself意为穿衣服。
